title: Business Development Executive
company: BPX Electro Mechanical Co Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
As BPX Group continues to grow, we are looking to strengthen our team and recruit a Business Development Executive to support the ambitious plans at our Northampton branch (NN5 7 UW). We are looking for someone with strong sales experience who possesses the skills needed to identify new business opportunities and lead growth initiatives within the existing portfolio. The ability to build relationships, work in a team, and continually learn will make the difference in this role. If you can bring high energy, initiative, and a technical interest to deliver the best solutions for customers, your career at BPX will fly.

About Us:

For 60 years BPX (part of the RS Group) has built a reputation as the leading independent distributor of factory automation and control components - from computers to connectors, from robots to relays and everything in between. We now employ over 180 people and from our 15 locations throughout the UK & Ireland, we provide a local service to our customers.

Our continued success comes from our passion for technology and commitment to customer service. We are a talented group across our UK and Ireland branch network and work towards our mission for our customers, "help to choose, help to use".

BPX are the strategic partner to market leading brands such as Schneider Electric, Mitsubishi, Omron and many more, offering innovative products, solutions and technical support to thousands of customers UK wide.

The main duties will include:

Deliver sales growth through the development of both new and existing businesses within the defined geographical area.

Build trust and develop strong relationships with customers, manufacturers, and colleagues to achieve 'win-win' outcomes for all stakeholders.

Adopt a consultative approach to sales, presenting solutions to customers that deliver value and help solve their industrial control and automation challenges

Balance the demands of prospecting for new business, in addition to enhancing relationships and contact points within the existing account portfolio.

Maintain a presence in the BPX branch, staying close to the people and local market.

Support marketing activities such as campaigns and promotions to increase customer awareness of product launches, events, competitions, etc.

Commit to learning, development, and training in both technical and non-technical areas.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience:

Experience in B2 B sales, ideally with knowledge of the industrial distribution market.

Drive sales growth opportunities through new and existing accounts/partnerships.

Familiar with the market dynamics between manufacturers, distributors, and customers.

Strong relationship builder, communicator, and team player.

Customer-centric, able to identify challenges and present solutions.

Organised and able to prioritise as required.

Committed to build knowledge across industrial control and automation products.

Familiar with CRM systems and able to produce sales reports.

BPX offers great benefits such as:

Minimum of 31 days annual leave including bank holidays (increasing with length of service)

Access to our training and development platform

Friendly and supportive work environment

Dress down Fridays

Access to the Employee Assistance Programme

Recruitment referral bonus

Opportunities for career progression

Cycle 2 Work scheme

Ability to carry forward unused holiday

Option to purchase additional annual leave

Free onsite parking

Emergency loans

BPX remains a financially secure business, offering the chance to work within a happy, friendly company with some wonderful and talented people.

title: Business Development Specialist - Internal Sales
description:
About Ricoh
A global leader in digital services, recognised for innovation, sustainability and a people-first culture. We feature in the Gartner Magic Quadrant, are listed in the Global 100 Most Sustainable Companies, and have been named one of Forbes' World's Best Employers 2025.

At Ricoh, we believe people do their best work when they feel valued and supported. We create inclusive workplaces where you can grow, contribute, and make a positive impact while helping to build a more sustainable future.

Find your place. Transform your future

Our purpose is centred on understanding and improving how people work. By focusing on real working experiences, we support individuals to develop their skills, realise their potential and do work that feels meaningful.

People transform when they Love What They Do

This belief sits at the heart of The Ricoh Promise. It guides how we recruit, how we support our people, and how we work together every day, creating an environment where you can grow, feel valued and make a difference.

When you join us, you are encouraged to share your ideas, challenge the way things are done, and work with others to build something better. If you are looking for a place where your voice is heard, your development is supported, and your work feels meaningful, you will feel at home at Ricoh.

What you will be doing
- To be accountable for successfully driving sales across new and existing customers within an assigned territory, ensuring adequate pipeline is in place to achieve and exceed targets.
- To understand and confidently articulate Modern Workplace Supplies portfolio and Ricoh's value proposition, keeping up to date with knowledge of these products and services to enhance and maintain strong creditability with customers.
- To be responsible for communicating product updates, promotions and incentives and work with internal teams to plan, agree and deliver sales and marketing activities, ensuring successful execution of campaigns and events to help increase brand visibility, customer engagement and drive sales.
- To be responsible for prospecting, account mapping and engaging with new and existing customers to create and develop sales opportunities.
- To develop and maintain strong relationships across Ricoh vendor network, enabling successful engagement and ensure the promotion of products and services to maximise potential opportunities.
- To lead proposals, relevant bid or tender engagements for Modern Workplace Supplies opportunities to ensure high quality proposals are developed and an increased win rate for Modern Workplace Supplies opportunities
- To be responsible for regular forecasting, monthly reporting, and CRM management to ensure Ricoh Management can track progress against budget.

You will ideally have
- Proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to take initiative and drive activity independently.
- Results-focused, resilient, and positive, with a strong commitment to ethical and inclusive behaviours.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment.
- Excellent presentation and written communication abilities.
- Demonstrates confidence in influencing and engaging stakeholders at all levels.
- Team-oriented, with a supportive approach to wider business objectives.
- Highly self-motivated, organised, and capable of managing own workload.
- Eagerness to learn, with a strong appetite for continuous development.
- Knowledge of the Modern Workplace Supplies market advantageous.
- Proven experience in a sales or business development environment.
- Experience using CRM systems is desirable

In return for your commitment, you can expect
At Ricoh, work should feel meaningful, supportive and fulfilling. The Ricoh Promise shapes your experience through four pillars that bring our culture to life.
Love to Connect

You become part of a global community built on openness, inclusion and genuine collaboration.
Across teams, countries and roles, you'll find people who listen, involve and encourage you - helping you feel valued and able to be yourself every day.
Love to Grow

Your development truly matters to us. With access to learning pathways, mentoring and career opportunities across functions and countries, you'll be supported to stretch your skills, explore new directions and stay future-ready in a changing world.
Love to Give Back

Purpose is part of how we work. You'll have opportunities to make a difference through volunteering, sustainability initiatives and community programmes that reflect our shared values and commitment to positive impact.
Love to Succeed

Success at Ricoh is something we pursue together. You'll benefit from fair rewards, flexible working, wellbeing resources and real recognition - including programmes such as the Imagine. Change. Awards, where colleagues celebrate each other's achievements.
We are an equal opportunities employer
We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential, and we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment journey, please let us know and we will support you to bring your best self forward.

Ready to love what you do? Apply now and help us shape what comes next.

title: Entry Level Sales Consultant - Insurance
description:
Sales Consultant - Insurance

Northampton 25,000 basic + Uncapped Monthly Bonus Full-Time, Permanent

Got a natural way with people? Enjoy sales and want a career where you can genuinely progress?

We're looking for confident, friendly and motivated individuals to join an established and award-winning business in Northampton.

You don't need insurance experience. What we're really interested in is people who have some experience in sales, whether that's working in retail, a call centre, hospitality or another customer-facing environment.

If you enjoy talking to people, building rapport and turning a conversation into a sale, this could be a great opportunity to develop your career.

What's the role?

You'll be joining a friendly sales team, speaking with customers interested in specialist insurance products covering caravans, park homes, boats, holiday homes and lodges.

It's a mixture of inbound and outbound telephone sales, with approximately 60% inbound calls and 40% outbound.

Importantly, this isn't about picking up the phone and cold calling random people. You'll be speaking with customers who have made enquiries, responded to marketing campaigns or are approaching their insurance renewal.

Your job is to understand what they're looking for, have a genuine conversation and help them find the right product.

Day-to-day responsibilities:
- Handle inbound enquiries and make outbound calls to prospective and existing customers.
- Build rapport and understand customers' needs through natural conversations.
- Provide quotations and explain suitable insurance products.
- Convert enquiries into sales and work towards achievable monthly targets.
- Deliver a positive customer experience from the initial conversation through to completion.
- Keep customer information accurate and up to date.
- Work alongside a supportive team to achieve individual and team targets.

What we're looking for

We're much more interested in your attitude, personality and sales ability than whether you've worked in insurance before.

You could currently be working in:
- Retail sales, where you're used to approaching customers and recommending products.
- A call centre or telephone-based sales environment.
- Hospitality or customer service, where building rapport comes naturally.
- A sales assistant or customer-facing role where you've worked towards targets.

Ideally, you'll have around a year's experience in a sales or customer-facing environment, but we're open to hearing from people with the right attitude and potential.

We're looking for someone who:
- Is naturally friendly, approachable and confident speaking with people.
- Enjoys having conversations and getting to know customers.
- Has a genuine interest in sales and achieving targets.
- Can recommend products without coming across as overly pushy.
- Is motivated to learn, develop and build a long-term career.
- Is reliable, positive and enjoys being part of a team.

You don't need to be a polished salesperson. Being down to earth, personable and comfortable talking to everyday customers is far more important.

What's in it for you?

This is more than just another sales job. The business is keen to develop people and give them the opportunity to grow their earnings and responsibilities as they progress.
- 24,785 starting basic salary, dependent on experience.
- Uncapped monthly bonus, giving you the opportunity to increase your earnings.
- Salary increases as you develop: As you learn and take on additional insurance products, your salary increases too.
- Full training from day one, with no previous insurance experience required.
- Genuine opportunities for career progression.
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 30 days with service.
- An additional day off for your birthday.
- A friendly, supportive working environment.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday, 9am-5.30pm, with one Saturday in every four weeks, 9am-1pm.

37.5 hours per week.

Interested?

If you've got some sales or customer-facing experience, enjoy speaking with people and want an opportunity to build a career with a company that will invest in your development, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Service Administrator

Customer Service Administrator

Location: Rushden, Northamptonshire NN10
Salary: £27,393.67 per annum
Hours: 36.25 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8:30am 4:30pm with a 45-minute unpaid lunch break

About the Role

Hawk 3 Talent Solutions are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented and enthusiastic Customer Service Administrator to join a manufacturing company based in Rushden.

In this role, you will be responsible for delivering excellent customer service by efficiently managing orders, handling customer enquiries and maintaining clear communication between customers and internal teams.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong communication and organisational skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and is committed to providing a high level of customer service.

Key Responsibilities
- Process and manage customer orders and forecasts, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.
- Handle inbound and outbound customer contact via telephone and email in a professional and timely manner.
- Diagnose customer issues, research solutions and provide accurate information to resolve concerns wherever possible at first contact.
- Proactively follow up with customers to ensure issues are resolved satisfactorily and help prevent recurring problems.
- Maintain accurate system information, ensuring data integrity and the removal of obsolete data.
- Provide administrative and logistical support to the external sales team.
- Liaise closely with technical support, sales and production teams to provide customers with accurate and up-to-date information.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal teams.
- Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling, introducing customers to additional products or services that meet their needs.
- Prepare and provide order information, reports and forecasts as required.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the customer experience and streamline internal processes.
- Maintain a comprehensive understanding of products to provide knowledgeable guidance and advice.
- Ensure compliance with relevant policies, quality standards and customer-specific requirements.

Qualifications & Experience
- Experience in a fast-paced office or customer service environment is essential.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word and Outlook, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.
- Experience within a manufacturing or distribution environment is desirable.
- Strong data entry accuracy and attention to detail.
- Commercial awareness and an understanding of customer needs and expectations.
- Previous experience handling telephone and email enquiries is advantageous.

Skills & Attributes
- Excellent telephone manner and written communication skills.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
- Ability to work independently, prioritise effectively and manage workload under pressure.
- Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach to teamwork.
- A positive, "can-do" attitude, including when dealing with challenging situations.
- Proactive, adaptable and eager to learn.
- Confident in building rapport and maintaining professional relationships.

Additional Requirements
- Commitment to Health & Safety, quality standards and good housekeeping practices.
- Ability to work effectively across multiple departments and locations.
- Reliability, punctuality and a customer-focused mindset.
- Willingness to support business needs and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

What We Offer

This is an excellent opportunity to join a busy customer-focused environment where you can develop your skills, build strong professional relationships and make a real contribution to the customer experience.

title: Internal Account Manager
company: M TWO Search Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
About you

You're someone who enjoys building relationships with customers, knows how to spot an opportunity and isn't afraid to pick up the phone.

You'll already have experience within print, signage, large-format graphics or exhibition displays, so you'll understand the products, the customers and how the industry works.

We're looking for someone who's commercially minded, organised and comfortable managing multiple accounts without letting things slip through the cracks.

Your experience

You'll have worked in internal sales, account management or a similar customer-facing role within the industry.

You'll be comfortable putting together quotations, following up on enquiries, developing existing relationships and finding ways to generate more business.

You don't need to be a hard-nosed salesperson, but you do need to enjoy the commercial side of account management and be confident having conversations with customers.

What you'll be doing

You'll be looking after a portfolio of up to 150 trade customers, becoming their main point of contact and helping grow the business they place.

A big part of the role will involve keeping in touch with existing customers, bringing lapsed accounts back on board and spotting opportunities to introduce additional products.

You'll also work closely with the wider sales and customer service teams, supporting regional sales targets, managing quotations and making sure customers are looked after properly.

It's a proactive role, so there'll be plenty of time spent on the phone rather than simply waiting for enquiries to come in.

About the business

You'll be joining an established business supplying display and exhibition solutions to trade customers across the industry.

They're continuing to grow, and this is an additional position within their sales operation to help develop customer relationships and increase revenue.

There's an established customer base to work with, a broad product offering and support from the wider team.

Next steps

If you've got experience within print, signage or displays and enjoy the relationship-building side of sales, we'd be keen to have a chat.

Drop us a message and we'll talk you through the opportunity.
